title: Drink from the Chalice of Corruption
wikitext:
Take your drink from the Chalice of the Corruption. {{Quest infobox | name = Drink from the Chalice of Corruption | campaign = Factions | region =Kaineng City | type = Secondary | given by = [[Brother Tosai]] | given at = [[Wajjun Bazaar]] | preceded by = [[Seek out Brother Tosai]] | followed by = [[Masters of Corruption]] }}__NOTOC__ ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Allow Brother Tosai to finish his ritual. * See Brother Tosai for your reward. ===Reward=== * 3,500 [[Experience]] * 275 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Just speak with [[Brother Tosai]] after accepting the reward for the quest [[Seek out Brother Tosai]], await his dialogue to finish, then collect the reward and the next quest in the series. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Brother Tosai''' :''"Are you here to accept the truth of your own flesh? You can become so much more if you dare drink from the [[Chalice of Corruption]]...."'' ::[[File:Tango-quest-icon.png]] ''"Drink from the Chalice of Corruption"'' ::[[File:Tango-quest-icon.png]] ''"[[Refuse to Drink]]"'' After choosing "Drink from the Chalice of Corruption": '''Brother Tosai''' :''"Only the strongest can survive a drink from the '''Chalice of Corruption'''. Have you the strength?"'' {{offer dialog |accept = Yes. I will drink. |decline = No. I'm not thirsty. |indent = :: }} After drinking:
'''Brother Tosai''' :''"O Chalice of Corruption, impart your strength on this mortal..."'' :''"Infuse this fleshy shell with the strength and power that is your gift..."'' :''"Take this flesh and make it more than it is, as only you can..."'' :''"Take this flesh and make it whole."'' Talking to Tosai before he finishes the above quotes:
'''Brother Tosai''' :''"Do not interrupt the ritual!"'' ===Reward dialogue=== '''Brother Tosai''' :'' "The Chalice of Corruption has a very invigorating effect, does it not? Soon you will truly be one of us. There is but one last thing you must do..."'' ==Notes== [[File:Chalice_Of_Corruption_Aura.jpg|thumb|150px|The effect as seen on a player in an outpost.]] * After drinking from the [[Chalice of Corruption]] you will have a -2 [[health degeneration]]. * Wait a few moments, then speak to Tosai again to receive the reward. The health degeneration will not be removed until completing the next quest, [[Masters of Corruption]]. * Completing the quest [[Masters of Corruption]] removes the -2 [[health degeneration]] and the visual effect. * The health degeneration is active even in [[PvP]], and will kill afflicted players even when not using [[vampiric]] weapons. * This quest is mutually exclusive with [[Refuse to Drink]]. * The effect animation is active when the player is in an outpost but does not cause -2 health degeneration.
